policy: A source is ACTIVE only after provenance, license/access terms, immutable raw snapshot, quality gate and publication are recorded. A verified endpoint is not the same as ingested data.

sources.publication: automatic only after blocking quality checks PASS

sources.notes: Do not activate a third-party mirror as official. Configure only a verified/licensed endpoint or controlled import.
Conecta access requires onboarding/credentials and network allow-listing. No credential is embedded.
Official polygon dataset is SHP-ZIP under ODbL. Adapter converts the selected CKAN SHP-ZIP resource with GDAL; activation remains explicit and quality-gated.
Official TerraBrasilis WFS base is identified. Exact current PRODES vector layer/typeName must be inspected, pinned and versioned before activation; no catch-all layer is assumed.
